title: Punctilio
summary: PUN'CTIL'IO, noun A nice point of exactness in conduct, ceremony or proceeding; particularity or exactness in forms; as the punctilios of a public ceremony.

inlines.v: PUN'CTIL'IO, noun A nice point of exactness in conduct, ceremony or proceeding; particularity or exactness in forms; as the punctilios of a public ceremony.
